evidence: Workday is the enterprise AI platform for managing people, money, and agents
cloud solutions powered by artificial intelligence (AI) to help solve some of today's most complex business challenges

During fiscal 2026, we expanded our AI capabilities through the acquisitions of FlowiseAI, Inc. (Flowise), a low-code platform that makes it easy to build AI agents; Paradox, Inc. (Paradox), a candidate experience agent that uses conversational AI; Sana Labs AB (Sana), a leading AI company building the next generation of enterprise knowledge tools; and Pipedream, Inc. (Pipedream), a leading integration platform for AI agents
The Workday Data Cloud is expected to become available later in fiscal 2027

we must demonstrate that our products and solutions are superior to other solutions available to their organizations, including generic LLMs, software created using natural language prompts and generative AI
ai_positioning.summary: Workday se positionne comme intégrateur d'IA, en incorporant des capacités IA natives dans ses solutions HCM et finance via acquisitions stratégiques (agents conversationnels, plateformes low-code, outils d'IA d'entreprise) plutôt que de développer ses propres modèles de base.
